about.title: A bit of my story
about.paragraph1: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8 years of experience in Java and .NET, with React and Angular frontends. Extensive retail experience, plus financial and industrial projects. 4 years with Oracle and always in agile Scrum teams.
about.paragraph2: Microservices, Clean Architecture, design patterns and REST/SOAP integration. Deployments on Azure (CI/CD in Azure DevOps), AWS (EKS, Lambda, CloudWatch) and GCP (Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage). I apply Clean Code and SOLID.

experience.title: Professional experience
experience.description: A summary of the roles and companies I've worked with.

achievements: Built new projects from start to finish: REST services in Java with Spring Boot and JPA on Oracle, React frontends and deployment on GCP.
Maintained the legacy .NET 5 and 6 systems for Finance, the SKU price management system and operations management, including their services and jobs.
Implemented publishing of product events with SKU, price and promotions to GCP Pub/Sub topics; the logistics system consumes them and loads them into CT3 on Oracle.
Migrated the Tax Management System (SGT) from .NET Framework to React and Java 21 with Spring Boot. It now responds faster and its APIs are ready to be reused by other systems.
Cut the Finance sales reconciliation batch from 2-4 hours to 6-10 minutes, about one million records, by processing it in parallel batches with CompletableFuture and loading the codes into memory.

Restructured the React frontend with validations and per-record tracing. Finance used to open 3 to 4 tickets a day for wrong codes and calculations, and up to 14 at month-end close; those tickets dropped noticeably.
Built REST APIs in Java 11 with Spring Boot for the packaging monitoring system of Gloria's plants, deployed on AWS EKS.
Built the dashboard that shows each line's packaging in real time, fed by APIs connected to the plant PLCs, and monitored the services with ELK and Kibana.

Integrated BCP, Interbank and Scotiabank into the group's Host to Host system, which handles bulk payroll and supplier payments: batches are generated in SAP and sent to each bank through SOAP services.
Migrated the payments platform from Windows Forms to a React and .NET web app. With bulk selection and permission management, Finance went from about 30 minutes to a few minutes per payment run.
Maintained and refactored the Finance system in .NET 6 and .NET Framework with Clean Architecture and CQRS, along with its PL/SQL packages.
Worked on the "Gloriosa" promotion, broadcast nationwide, with AWS Lambda functions and Python scripts.
REST APIs in Java with Spring Boot for the Accounting area of Juntoz.com.
In React, maintenance of the web application and new modules integrated with those APIs.
CI/CD on Azure DevOps.
REST APIs in Java with Spring Boot and React frontend.
The "Finanzas Atlantic" app with ETL processes from SAP, SQL Server and Oracle.
An API Gateway with Kong Enterprise.
Led a team of 4.
Built the CVT application in ASP.NET MVC for BCP's ARPAY tribe, integrated with Oracle and with CI/CD on Jenkins.
Supported the tribe's teams.
Maintenance of Angular 11 and .NET Core/Entity Framework applications for Ferreyros business processes, with continuous delivery on Azure DevOps.
Led and built the Calidda GNV and Data Update apps; mobile apps in Kotlin/Swift.
Built new modules (credit evaluation, card issuance, loan approval) and SOAP/REST services for Compartamos Financiera.
Development and support with ASP.NET Web Forms, Xamarin and Telerik components for BBVA, Entel and Pacífico.

projects.description: A selection of personal and professional projects.

fund-transfer-engine.description: A 2-microservice Java ecosystem that orchestrates fund transfers using the Saga pattern (orchestrated choreography), with automatic compensation on failure.
highlights: Orchestrated Saga pattern with a state machine (PENDING → RESERVED → COMPLETED / CANCELLED_COMPENSATED / FAILED).
Internal communication via gRPC between transaction-orchestrator-service (external gateway) and account-ledger-service (accounting core, closed to the outside).
Automatic compensation (rollback) on simulated confirmation failures, releasing reserved funds.
Combined use of Virtual Threads (Java 21) in the orchestrator and reactive programming (Mutiny) in the ledger, each justified by its contention profile.
Resilience via Circuit Breaker, Retry with backoff/jitter and Bulkhead, configured differently per operation.
Real-time event streaming via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
Distributed tracing across microservices with traceId propagation.
Kubernetes deployment with included manifests (Deployment + Service + health probes).

agile-flow-board.description: A Scrum-based project management system with task administration and real-time Kanban boards.
highlights: Kanban boards with drag & drop using Angular CDK.
Real-time updates via SignalR (task movement, notifications).
Hexagonal Architecture on the backend (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api).
JWT authentication with PBKDF2 password hashing (salt + pepper).

grupo-ciencias.description: A full platform for a pre-university academy: institutional landing page, management intranet and a Netflix-style virtual library of educational content.
highlights: Institutional landing page for student acquisition.
Virtual library with a streaming-style interface (video class/content catalog).
React frontend integrated with a .NET backend.
